title: Comparative Performance of Machine Learning Architectures for Fault Detection and Diagnosis in Chemical Processes
abstract: arXiv:2611.27696v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fault Detection and Diagnosis (FDD) is crucial for both maintenance and control in chemical industries, where early fault detection can prevent costly failures and optimize operations. This is particularly critical in pilot units like those at IFP Energies Nouvelles (IFPEN), which operate under short-term experimental conditions with frequently varying operational parameters. This study conducts an extensive benchmarking analysis using the Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP), a widely used simulated chemical process dataset, to evaluate multiple approaches for fault detection and diagnosis, featuring numerous continuous operations with different sensors and faults. translated_title: 化工过程中用于故障检测与诊断的机器学习架构性能比较
translated_abstract: 故障检测与诊断（FDD）对化工行业的维护与控制至关重要，早期故障检测能够避免代价高昂的设备失效并优化运行。这在IFP Energies Nouvelles（IFPEN）等中试装置中尤为关键，因为这类装置在短期实验条件下运行，操作参数经常变化。本研究基于田纳西-伊士曼过程（TEP）——一个被广泛使用的模拟化工过程数据集——开展了全面的基准测试分析，以评估多种故障检测与诊断方法，其中包含大量具有不同传感器和故障类型的连续运行场景。研究实现并比较了多种方法，包括用于故障检测的多尺度PCA（MS-PCA）、自编码器、集成学习（Ensemble Learning）和LSTM模型，以及用于故障诊断的随机森林、XGBoost和BLSTM（双向LSTM）。我们的结果表明，集成学习……
tldr: 本研究以田纳西-伊士曼过程（TEP）为基准，系统比较了多种机器学习架构（包括集成学习、LSTM、XGBoost等）在化工过程故障检测与诊断任务中的性能，为实际工业场景下的方法选择提供了依据。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks multiple machine learning architectures—including ensemble learning, LSTM, and gradient boosting methods—for fault detection and diagnosis in chemical processes using the Tennessee Eastman Process dataset.
